verdict.rationale: Notion markets AI features like natural-language Q&A with citations and autonomous 'agents' that keep work moving, plus an official MCP server enabling AI clients to operate the workspace conversationally. However, evidence is thin marketing copy with no concrete examples or independent hands-on confirmation that natural-language commands reliably create/edit workspace content end-to-end. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of NL command scope/limits, independent or hands-on validation of agentic NL actions succeeding, and clarity on how MCP/agents translate free-text into reliable actions.
